name: Gonzalo Thought
summary: Gonzalo Thought is the Peruvian Communist Party (Shining Path) application of Marxism-Leninism-Maoism to Peru, set out by Abimael Guzman as 'Presidente Gonzalo'. It makes the conquest and defence of power through universal people's war its centre, with a militarised Party commanding the army, a democratic stage under a worker-peasant front, then socialism and successive cultural revolutions. It rejects elections, revisionism and imperialism, and it names Guzman as head of the Party and the revolution.
scope: The party's own line as written in its 1988 Foundational Documents and in the 1988 El Diario interview with Gonzalo, plus scholarship on how it worked. It covers the Peruvian Communist Party (Shining Path) under Guzman until his 1992 capture. It leaves out Maoism in general, later splinters, and the party's actions, since the party was never the governing party of a state.

abolish-armed-forces.rationale: The programme builds a revolutionary army and says without a people's army the people have nothing; the new state rests on the armed people.

all-land-state-owned.rationale: The programme hands confiscated land to the peasantry 'in property', not to the state.

armed-resistance-to-occupation.rationale: The programme defends the country against imperialist aggression with people's war and supports the struggles of oppressed nations.

capitalism-causes-war.rationale: Gonzalo describes world war as the imperialist superpowers' war of plunder over hegemony and says the root must be swept away.

class-collaboration.rationale: The party's line is class struggle and annihilation of the old ruling class; collaboration of employers and workers as partners is revisionist.

class-struggle-history.rationale: The principles list class struggle and 'the masses make history', and revolution is defined as the violent replacement of one class by another.

class-struggle-under-socialism.rationale: The text presents the theory that class struggle continues under the dictatorship of the proletariat, with restoration and counter-restoration, as Mao's central development, and treats the 1976 coup in China as restoration.

clerical-rule.rationale: The party calls the church hierarchy an old theocracy serving oppressors and separates church from state, so clerical rule is excluded.

colonial-socialism-democratic-stage.rationale: The programme sets a democratic first stage, then a socialist second stage, for a society oppressed by imperialism, bureaucratic capitalism and semi-feudalism, passing 'without any intermediary' to socialism.

defeat-communism.rationale: The party's aim is communism worldwide, so it opposes defeating it.

democracy-best.rationale: The party treats parliamentary democracy as the bourgeois dictatorship (the US as the model) and boycotts elections; its own state is a joint dictatorship, so it rejects democracy as the best form.

dictatorship-of-proletariat.rationale: The programme holds the dictatorship of the proletariat indispensable to march to communism and continued through cultural revolutions.

direct-action.rationale: Gonzalo says the main thing about elections is to boycott and if possible prevent them, since the people gain nothing from renewing the old order's authorities.

independence-needs-economic-change.rationale: Gonzalo says nationalist movements without a Communist party only change masters, and that real liberation needs the confiscation of imperialist and bureaucratic capital.

informal-organisation.rationale: The party is centralised and militarised, a permanent organisation with a Central Committee, which excludes small informal groups.

land-redistribution.rationale: Objective 4 liquidates semi-feudal landholding and gives the land to the peasantry under 'the land for those who work it'; the interview describes the land invasions the party promoted.

laws-from-scripture.rationale: A programme that separates church from state and treats the old theocracy as a reactionary shield leaves no room for scripture-based law.

leader-cult.rationale: The party makes Gonzalo 'Jefe del Partido y de la revolución' whose thought carries his name, yet he rejected the 'cult of personality' charge as a revisionist smear, so the record is mixed.

market-under-party-rule.rationale: The party condemns Deng and the post-1976 restoration of capitalism in China as revisionism.

material-conditions-drive-history.rationale: The text condemns the revisionist thesis of the productive forces and says the superstructure and consciousness can change the base, with politics in command.

military-organisation-revolutionary-part.rationale: The programme lists militarisation of the Party as a basic principle and the interview affirms it.

monarchy-legitimate.rationale: The programme's goal is a People's Republic as a class front under the proletariat, with the exploiting classes' state demolished, which excludes a hereditary monarch.

national-resource-control.rationale: The programme confiscates imperialist enterprises and holdings in Peru, putting them under the new state.

neither-capitalism-nor-communism.rationale: Communism is the party's final goal, so it rejects a third course.

no-transition-to-communism.rationale: The programme requires the democratic, socialist and successive cultural revolutions, and says without the dictatorship of the proletariat one cannot march to communism.

one-party-rule.rationale: The foundational text says the Party must come to lead everything 'omnimodamente', both in the new-democracy front and the dictatorship of the proletariat.

opposition-only-legal-channels.rationale: The party's whole programme is armed struggle against a state it holds illegitimate, rejecting legal-only opposition.

parliamentary-road-socialism.rationale: Gonzalo attacks the parliamentary left as revisionist and says the electoral road offers no solution.

party-commands-army.rationale: The programme demands a revolutionary army under the Party's absolute direction, quoting Mao that the Party commands the gun and the reverse will never be allowed.

party-discipline-binding.rationale: The Party is organised as a militarised, centralised body with iron leadership and rectification campaigns that fit members to the adopted line; the scholarship records that real members did challenge decisions.

party-own-road.rationale: The programme names independence, self-decision and self-reliance as a basic principle, and says the universal truth is applied to each revolution's concrete conditions.

people-in-arms.rationale: The text carries Lenin's popular militia further toward an armed sea of masses, yet also builds a separate new-type army under the Party, so the position points both ways.

promote-democracy-abroad.rationale: The party treats liberal democracy as bourgeois dictatorship and opposes imperialist intervention, so it opposes promoting it abroad.

property-fundamental.rationale: Confiscation of imperialist, bureaucratic-capitalist and semi-feudal property is the democratic revolution's central programme.

public-ownership.rationale: The programme confiscates imperialist monopolies, banks and enterprises and all bureaucratic-capitalist property for the new state, so large industry passes to public ownership (the national bourgeoisie's property is respected).

religion-illusion.rationale: He calls 'religion is the opium of the people' a fully valid Marxist thesis and says religion will die out as exploitation is swept away.

separate-church-state.rationale: Gonzalo says the first thing the party does is separate Church from State, while respecting freedom to believe and not to believe.

smash-state-machine.rationale: The first objective of the democratic revolution is to demolish the Peruvian state, its armed forces and its whole bureaucratic apparatus.

socialism-needs-revolutionary-war.rationale: Violence is a universal law and people's war the proletariat's universal military theory; revolution in imperialist countries can only be conceived as revolutionary war.

socialism-one-country.rationale: The text stresses world revolution as a unit, quoting 'we all enter communism or no one does', and ties power in Peru to proletarian power worldwide.

sovereign-debt-cancellation.rationale: Objective 2 confiscates imperialist property 'including the external debt', which Gonzalo calls the only way to lift that weight from nations.

soviet-state-capitalist.rationale: The party holds that the Soviet Union was socialist until capitalism was restored after Stalin and then became social-imperialist, which splits the statement by period.

state-class-instrument.rationale: It develops the Marxist theory of the state as the dictatorship of the class or classes holding power, with bourgeois, proletarian and new-democracy types.

vanguard-party.rationale: The party is described as the organised vanguard of the proletariat, a selected 'war machine' of the best, not a mass party; a front without Communist Party leadership is called a negation of Marxism.

worker-farmer-alliance.rationale: The worker-peasant alliance is the basis of the front and of the People's Republic, guaranteeing proletarian hegemony.

workers-anti-imperialist-capitalist-alli.rationale: The front is led by the proletariat, and Gonzalo says the national bourgeoisie can take part in it under certain circumstances.

workers-own-party.rationale: The proletariat must be led by its own Communist Party, the vanguard that conducts the front and the war.

world-economy-extracts-surplus.rationale: The text speaks of imperialist economic relations 'esquilmando' (bleeding) oppressed nations and links them to bureaucratic capitalism.

notes: Answers rest on the party's 1988 documents and interview; the party never governed a state, so its words answer where they speak and its acts (such as the Lucanamarca massacre) are not treated as the ideology's record. Themes not covered by those texts (economy details, society, technology, ecology, most of government) are null. Statements on universal people's war and a militarised party were already proposed in the bank by the statement pass.
